projectPreferences: Thread length 2..25 is this workbench scope, not an official X maximum.
Ordinary post plus thread produces two documents inside one platform-language content package.
title is empty; blocks[].text contains exact future submitted text; no automatic numbering, trimming or splitting.
One successful review per platform-language content package covers its ordinary post and complete thread; deterministic checks remain separate.
Image rules, API permissions, actual model validation and real publication have independent evidence.
